task.name: Pentagon-free graphs without independent 9-sets (Ramsey number R(C5,K9))
task.family: science prize i c5 versus k9
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 35 containing no 5-cycle (as a subgraph) and no independent set of 9 vertices, both checked exactly. Maximize n. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(C5,K9) > n; the best known has 32 vertices and no valid graph has more than 35.
